Author: Kuldeep Mathur Bench: Kuldeep Mathur

HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR  S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous Bail Application No. 14770/2022 Lokesh S/o Lt. Devi Lal, Aged About 26 Years, Naleke Pass, Near Teliyo Ki Sati Mata, Dadabadi Khatik Mohalla, P.s. Bheemgunj,
Bhilwara, Dist. Bhilwara (Raj.).

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
(Presently Lodged In Dist. Jail,
Bhilwara).
 ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. N.K. Gurjar For Respondent(s) : Mr. Mahipal Bishnoi, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 20/01/2023

This application for bail has been filed by the petitioner under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. in connection with FIR No.465/2022, Police Station Subhash Nagar, Bhilwara for the offences under Sections 344, 366 and 376(2)(AN) of the Indian Penal Code.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor and also perused the material available on record.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that though the prosecutrix had consensual relationship with the present petitioner and travelled with him at various places as disclosed by her in her statement recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C., yet, she with an intention to falsely implicate the petitioner in a criminal case, has lodged the present FIR against him.
Therefore, the petitioner may be enlarged on bail.
[CRLMB-14770/2022] Learned Public Prosecutor vehemently opposed this bail application.

Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case; perusing the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. and without expressing any opinion on the merits/demerits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the bail application filed by the petitioner deserves to be accepted.

Lokesh vs State Of Rajasthan on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/66193767/
1
Consequently, the bail application filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed.

It is ordered that petitioner Lokesh S/o Late Devi Lal, arrested in connection with FIR No.465/2022, P.S. Subhash Nagar, Bhilwara shall be released on bail; provided he executes personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- and two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Court.
Petitioner shall be required to appear before that Court on all dates of hearing and as and when called upon to do so.
(KULDEEP MATHUR),J 47-skm/-
